candidates.title: Civitai prompt 150318237
candidates.prompt:
Vintage Halloween screenprint poster with Pop surrealism energy, dreamlike pastel palette, uncanny whimsy, coarse halftone dots, soft ink registration drift, flat graphic shapes, and eerie carnival mood.
A stagnant marsh spreads across the bottom of the composition, painted in layered washes of seafoam green, dusty teal, and pale violet fog. The sky is a flat sickly turquoise field, crossed by thin cream cloud bands and a faint apricot glow near the horizon. Cattails, broken fences, and distant leafless shapes sit behind the main tree as simplified black silhouettes.
A colossal skeletal dead tree dominates the center, its trunk leaning slightly and its branches curling outward like hooked claws. The bark is rendered as pale ash grey plates shaped into gaunt rib forms, with hollow dark gaps between each rib curve. Dozens of mismatched pale-yellow eyes stare from knotholes across the trunk and limbs, some round, some almond shaped, some half lidded, all glowing with flat buttery ink and soft halo dots. The tree carries a strong ink-hatched silhouette, built from black contour lines, stippled shadows, and coarse print texture.
A tiny wide-eyed traveler stands at the base of the roots in the lower right foreground, planted on a thick mossy root with both feet. The traveler leans back slightly, shoulders raised, elbows bent, and both hands gripping a flickering brass lantern near the chin. The face is small but clear, with enlarged eyes, a parted mouth, and a stunned upward gaze toward the watching tree. The lantern throws a warm orange cone across the roots and the traveler's coat, while cold mint ambient light rims the tree bark and fog banks.
The image uses pastel screenprint color, with mint, teal, lilac, cream, pale yellow, rust orange, and charcoal black. Halftone dots thicken in the shadows and soften in the glowing eyes. Slight ink misregistration creates ghost edges around the branches and lantern light. Fine details include cracked root ridges, wet marsh reflections, tiny paper fiber specks, and soft luminous rings around each pale-yellow eye.
